title: Kainos band spec (bandgen v0.1)
description: The per-band 'training data' source of truth for the tutor curriculum. A band spec declares everything a human authored (concepts, lessons, theorems, walls, the turn script, predictions); bandgen computes the rest (beds from reference functions, carry bytes from the seed store, pre-states from a runtime boot, letters/answers from a dry-run) and reports the diff. Freeze a band when the control report is clean.

seed.description: The seed store: the previous band's OFFICIAL final store.

store.description: Repo-relative path to the seed store JSON

registry.description: The brainstem concepts tuple to boot the runtime with, e.g. 'CONCEPTS_E617'. The spec's concepts must be a subset of it (the dry-run needs the full carried registry).

unconditional.description: true => P0 marker ABSENCE discipline (no conditional marker on band facts); false => the S12 marker rule (every conditional statement carries the marker)

marker_kept_facts.description: Carried facts that MUST keep the condition marker (no drift)

prereqs.description: Prereq concept ids; must point DOWN (exist in the seed registry, or be an earlier concept of this band)

statement.description: The FULL canonical statement, verbatim (house rule: the lesson line is the exact stored byte)

parts.description: The STRICT sanctioned premise set (lesson slugs); derive-scaffolds use exactly this set

statement.description: The full canonical theorem statement, verbatim

new_fact_ids.description: Every fact id this band stores (the 4+3 pattern), in store order: lessons first, then theorems

turns.description: The full labeled script, in run order (sessions in ascending order). Every turn declares its kind from the closed set.

ref.description: Zero-padded turn coordinate, e.g. S02:05 (session 2, fifth turn)

bed.description: present on 'probe' turns whose answer is an on-line BED (the grounded value the store must hold exact)

value.description: required when expect=literal: the exact expected answer byte; when expect=frac, the exact expected byte as rendered (the control also checks the reference value)

template.description: frac only: the answer template with {v} = the rendered fraction (default '{v}'); example 'it multiplies by {v}'

ref.description: frac only: the reference function name (reflib registry)

grounds.description: The grounded citation fact ids (the store's own grounding set)

cite.description: Theorem slugs the answer must quote the sanctioned statement for (feeds the theorem_allowed table)

concept.description: gap only: the untaught concept whose absence the answer must name

fragment.description: gap only: the exact fragment the answer must carry (the concept / rule name as the mechanism names it)

lesson.description: teach only: the lesson slug being taught (fact id = 'lemma:' + slug)

parts.description: derive: the sanctioned part set (must equal the theorem's parts); scaffold: the GIVEN (wrong/short) part set

expected.description: scaffold/missing_parts/zero_derive/zero_touch/unclassified only: the exact frozen answer byte (the mechanism's honest articulation, captured at control)

text.description: The exact frozen answer byte (starts with 'needs_info: ')

articulation.description: The fragments the byte must carry; every wall must name its value(s) AND the line end

source.description: carry only: where this surface's answer was first established (byte resolved from the band's SEED store via a seed-only runtime)

band.description: The source experiment id, e.g. e6.16

offscript.description: Off-script standing probes run on the SEED-ONLY runtime (the SAVANT-TRACK carries); not part of the labeled script

expect_derived.description: the seed-only answer must be a grounded derivation

beds.description: The band's numeric bed table (the S*_BEDS equivalent). Every key is either computed from a reference function or a declared off-line literal.

value.description: declared literal (off-line witness constants, orderings, line end)

expect.description: The author's PREDICTIONS (control #1 replaces them; the D-e6z deviation class lives here, and the control report diffs prediction vs mechanism)

letters.description: Predicted per-session letter sequences (L U F T S C H A; e614 mapping + A for ambiguous)

mastery.description: The new concepts' correct band-end mastery: {concept: {state, correct}}

prereq_gaps.description: The new concepts' frozen prereq-gap sets at band end

offline_watch.description: The declared OFF-LINE witness literals the hygiene scan must never find in on-line derived answers (the wall-named values, the standing-invitation numbers). The line end is deliberately NOT here.
